obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration

obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(5(a))

obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration

obligations.quote: Upon the filing of a request for judicial intervention, the court shall promptly send a notice to parties advising them of the time and place of the settlement conference, the purpose of the conference and the requirements of this section.

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration

obligations.quote: The notice shall be in a form prescribed by the office of court administration, or, at the discretion of the office of court administration, the administrative judge of the judicial district in which the action is pending.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Advise a pro se defendant of the nature of the action and the defendant's rights and responsibilities.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(5(c))
obligations.quote: If the defendant is appearing pro se, the court shall advise the defendant of the nature of the action and his or her rights and responsibilities as a defendant.

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Advise a defendant who has not answered of the requirement to answer and explain how, at the first settlement conference.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(5(d))
obligations.quote: if the defendant has not filed an answer or made a pre-answer motion to dismiss, the court shall (i) advise the defendant of the requirement to answer the complaint, (ii) explain what is required to answer a complaint in court,
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Set a deadline for co-tenants requesting partition by sale and provide information on legal assistance resources at the first settlement conference.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(5(d))
obligations.quote: (iv) set a deadline for any co-tenants requesting partition by sale, and (v) provide information about available resources for legal assistance.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.actor_raw: the referee, judicial hearing officer, or other staff designated by the court

obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(5(f))
obligations.quote: the referee, judicial hearing officer, or other staff designated by the court to oversee the settlement conference process shall make a report of findings of fact, conclusions of law and recommendations for relief to the court concerning any party's failure to negotiate in good faith
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Dismiss the partition action if the plaintiff failed to negotiate in good faith.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(5(f))
obligations.quote: If the court determines a plaintiff has failed to negotiate in good faith, the partition action shall be dismissed.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Determine the fair market value of heirs property.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(6(a))
obligations.quote: the court shall determine the fair market value of the heirs property for purposes of subdivision seven of this section as follows
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Adopt the value or valuation method agreed to by all co-tenants.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(6(b))
obligations.quote: If all co-tenants have agreed to the value of the property or to another method of valuation, the court shall adopt such value or the value produced by the agreed method of valuation.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Determine fair market value after an evidentiary hearing and notify the parties when an appraisal costs more than it is worth.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(6(c))
obligations.quote: the court, after an evidentiary hearing, shall determine the fair market value of the property and send notice of the value to the parties.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Order an appraisal by a disinterested licensed real estate appraiser.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(6(d))
obligations.quote: the court shall order an appraisal by a disinterested real estate appraiser licensed in this state to determine the fair market value of the property.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Send each party notice of the appraisal, its availability and the right to object, within ten days of filing.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(6(e))
obligations.quote: Not later than ten days after an appraisal is filed under paragraph (d) of this subdivision, the court shall send notice to each party with a known address, stating:
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Conduct a hearing to determine fair market value after the appraisal notice period.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(6(f))
obligations.quote: the court shall conduct a hearing to determine the fair market value of the property not sooner than thirty days after a copy of the notice of the appraisal is sent to each party
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Determine the fair market value and notify the parties before considering the merits.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(6(g))
obligations.quote: the court shall determine the fair market value of the property and send notice to the parties of the value.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Notify all parties of the owners seeking partition by sale and the remaining co-tenants' right to buy them out.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(a))
obligations.quote: the court shall send notice to all parties identifying the owners of interests that have sought partition by sale, the percentage interests such owners allege to hold
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Determine each co-tenant's percentage ownership when disputed, before sending notice of value.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(b))
obligations.quote: the court shall make a determination of each co-tenant's percentage ownership interest in the property prior to sending notice of the determination of value if such interest is in dispute
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Notify all parties when co-tenants have elected to buy the interests subject to purchase.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(d)(i))

obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Allocate the right to buy interests among electing co-tenants and notify the parties of the price each pays.

obligations.quote: the court shall allocate the right to buy those interests among the electing co-tenants based on each electing co-tenant's existing fractional ownership
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Notify the parties and resolve the partition under subdivision eight when co-tenants do not elect to buy all interests.

obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Set the date by which electing co-tenants must pay their apportioned price into court.

obligations.quote: the court shall set a date, not sooner than sixty days after the date the notice was sent, by which electing co-tenants must pay their apportioned price into the court.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Reallocate co-tenant interests and disburse the amounts held when all electing co-tenants pay on time.

obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.action_summary: Resolve the partition under subdivision eight when no electing co-tenant pays on time.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(e)(ii))
obligations.quote: If no electing co-tenant timely pays his or her apportioned price, the court shall resolve the partition action under paragraphs (a) and (b) of subdivision eight of this section
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Notify paying co-tenants of the unpurchased interests remaining and their price when some electing co-tenants fail to pay.

obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Reallocate the remaining interest to the single co-tenant who pays the entire price.

obligations.quote: If only one co-tenant pays the entire price for the remaining interest, the court shall issue an order reallocating the remaining interest to such co-tenant.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Resolve the partition under subdivision eight when no co-tenant pays for the remaining interest.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(f)(ii))
obligations.quote: If no co-tenant pays the entire price for the remaining interest, the court shall resolve the partition action under paragraphs (a) and (b) of subdivision eight of this section
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.action_summary: Reapportion remaining interests among co-tenants who each pay the entire price, and refund any excess payment.

obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.quote: the court shall order partition in kind unless the court, after consideration of the factors listed in subdivision nine of this section, finds that partition in kind will result in great manifest prejudice to the co-tenants as a group.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Approve a request by two or more parties to aggregate their interests when considering partition in kind.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(8(a))
obligations.quote: the court shall approve a request by two or more parties to have their individual interests aggregated.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Order partition by sale when partition in kind is not ordered, or dismiss the action if no co-tenant requested a sale.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(8(b))
obligations.quote: the court shall order partition by sale pursuant to subdivision ten of this section provided that, if no co-tenant timely requested partition by sale, the court shall dismiss the action.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Allocate to unknown, missing or defaulted co-tenants a part of the property representing their combined interests, to remain undivided.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(8(d))
obligations.quote: the court shall allocate to the co-tenants that are unknown, cannot be located, or the subject of a default judgment, if the co-tenants interests were not bought out pursuant to subdivision seven of this section, a part of the property
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Consider the statutory factors in deciding whether partition in kind would cause great manifest prejudice.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(9(a))
obligations.quote: In determining under subdivision eight of this section whether partition in kind would result in great manifest prejudice to the co-tenants as a group, the court shall consider the following:
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Conduct a court-ordered sale of heirs property as an open-market sale unless sealed bids or an auction is more advantageous.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(10(a))
obligations.quote: such sale shall be an open-market sale under this subdivision unless the court finds that a sale by sealed bids or an auction would be more economically advantageous and in the best interest of the co-tenants as a group.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the uniform partition of heirs property act

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Appoint a disinterested licensed broker and set a reasonable commission for an open-market sale.
obligations.citation: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(10(b))

obligations.law_title: Relates to county, city, village or town commissions on human rights

obligations.law_title: Relates to county, city, village or town commissions on human rights
